name: Triumph Science & Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: Triumph Science & Technology Co., Ltd., founded in 2000 and headquartered in Bengbu, China, operates globally, focusing on the research, manufacturing, and sale of electronic information display products and advanced new materials. The company's diverse new materials portfolio includes fused zirconia, zirconium silicate, spherical quartz powder, synthetic silicon dioxide, nano barium titanate, and various rare earth polishing powders. In its electronic information display segment, offerings span ITO conductive film glass, vacuum-coated glass, cover glass, flexible films, display modules, and touch modules, alongside other optoelectronic products and accessories. Beyond its core production, Triumph Science & Technology provides system integration services (from development to sales) and offers consulting and technical expertise for new materials. It also manufactures and supplies siliceous and aluminum powder materials for the fine ceramics, fine chemicals, and electronics industries. The company's business activities extend to trading chemical raw materials, building supplies, machinery, and equipment, as well as providing information consulting. Furthermore, it manages both the export of its own products and technologies, and the import of essential raw materials, instruments, mechanical equipment, spare parts, and related technologies. The company previously operated as Anhui Fangxing Science & Technology Co., Ltd. before officially adopting the name Triumph Science & Technology Co., Ltd. in April 2016.
